IC1: - Received liver transplant for treatment of hATTR amyloidosis ≥12 months before study start
IC2: - Has increase in polyneuropathy disability (PND) score after liver transplant
IC3: - Has received stable immunosuppressive regimen [AND] with ≤10 mg/day of prednisone for at least 3 months before study start
IC5: - Has vitamin A level greater than or equal to lower limit of normal
